title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Interactive Red-Black Self-Balancing Binary Search Tree Rotator Lab
body:
## Problem
Students and game-engine devs often struggle with **Red-Black Tree** recoloring and left/right rotation invariants during insertion and deletion.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/red-black-tree-lab.js` and `assets/css/red-black-tree-lab.css` (260+ LOC):
   - Implement full Red-Black Tree (`insert`, `delete`, `leftRotate`, `rightRotate`, `fixInsert`, `fixDelete`) with animated step-by-step transition logs explaining each case (`Uncle Red`, `Triangle Left-Right`, `Line Rotation`).
   - Live black-height indicator and invariant validator badge.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/SVG or Canvas/CSS3, zero external libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-red-black-tree-lab.js` asserting all 5 Red-Black invariants (root black, no red-red parent-child, uniform black-height on all root-to-NIL paths) across random insert/delete sequences.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every insertion and deletion preserves all 5 Red-Black invariants.
- [ ] Step-by-step mode highlights rotations and recoloring decisions clearly.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-red-black-tree-lab.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Minimax Alpha-Beta Pruning & Zobrist Transposition Table Tree Inspector
body:

## Architectural Scope & Requirements

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Node inspector displays `[alpha, beta]` bounds and Zobrist transposition cache hits.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-alphabeta-tree-lab.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Lock-Free Ring Buffer & Raft Consensus State-Machine Cluster Simulator
body:
## Problem
Distributed-systems learners lack an interactive **Raft Consensus** simulator in ArcadeVerse demonstrating leader election, randomized election timeouts, split-vote recovery, and log replication.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/raft-consensus-lab.js` and `assets/css/raft-consensus-lab.css` (280+ LOC):
   - Implement deterministic/steppable Raft node state machine (`Follower`, `Candidate`, `Leader`), `RequestVote` & `AppendEntries` RPC packets in flight, network partition toggles, and node crash/restart.
   - Visual cluster ring with animated RPC envelopes and per-node replicated log indices.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas/CSS3, zero external libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-raft-consensus-lab.js` verifying single-leader-per-term invariant, majority quorum election, and log-index commitment after partition heal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] At most one leader is elected per term, even under simulated network partitions.
- [ ] Replicated logs converge across recovered nodes once majority quorum is restored.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-raft-consensus-lab.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Voronoi Lloyd Relaxation & Centroidal Stipple Territory Generator
body:
## Problem
Procedural map generators use **Lloyd's Relaxation** on Voronoi diagrams to turn clumped random seeds into evenly spaced organic regions, a technique not yet showcased in ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/voronoi-lloyd-lab.js` and `assets/css/voronoi-lloyd-lab.css` (260+ LOC):
   - Implement clipped half-plane / Fortune-or-Delaunay-dual Voronoi cell polygon builder + polygon centroid calculation + iterative **Lloyd Relaxation** stepper.
   - Interactive seed placement, relaxation iteration counter, and island-biome elevation coloring mode.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external geometry libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-voronoi-lloyd-lab.js` verifying Voronoi nearest-site property on cell centroids and variance reduction in cell areas after Lloyd iterations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each Lloyd step moves seeds toward their Voronoi cell centroids, reducing area variance.
- [ ] Users can add/drag sites and switch between wireframe cells and biome map view.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-voronoi-lloyd-lab.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Emulator]: 6502 Assembly Mini-Computer, Live Zero-Page Memory & 32x32 Pixel Bus
body:
## Problem
ArcadeVerse's emulator tools lack a classic **MOS 6502** subset CPU & two-pass assembler with a memory-mapped 32x32 color display (`$0200-$05FF`) like classic retro consoles.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/mos6502-sandbox.js` and `assets/css/mos6502-sandbox.css` (320+ LOC):
   - Implement core 6502 opcodes (`LDA, LDX, LDY, STA, STX, ADC, SBC, INC, DEC, INX, DEX, CMP, BEQ, BNE, BCC, BCS, JMP, JSR, RTS, BRK`) with addressing modes (`Immediate, ZeroPage, Absolute, Indexed`).
   - Built-in two-pass assembler, `A/X/Y/SP/PC/NV-BDIZC` register inspector, hex memory viewer, and 32x32 RGB pixel screen mapped to `$0200-$05FF`.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas/CSS3, zero external libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-mos6502-sandbox.js` testing arithmetic carry/zero/negative flags, subroutine `JSR/RTS` stack round-trips, and assembler branch-offset encoding.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Assembles and executes sample 6502 programs (gradient fill, bouncing sprite) on the 32x32 display.
- [ ] Step, Run, Reset, and register/stack inspection work accurately.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-mos6502-sandbox.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Emulator]: Deterministic Brainfuck & Tape-Machine Optimizing JIT Step Debugger
body:
## Problem
ArcadeVerse has no visual **Turing-tape / Brainfuck** optimizing interpreter showing bracket-jump pairing, run-length instruction folding (`++++` -> `ADD 4`), and live tape-head memory.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/tape-vm-debugger.js` and `assets/css/tape-vm-debugger.css` (250+ LOC):
   - Implement parser/validator (balanced `[`/`]`), IR optimizer (folding repeated `+/-/</>`, clear-loop `[-]` -> `ZERO`), and step/breakpoint execution with cycle cap.
   - Visual tape strip with active pointer highlight, ASCII/Hex output console, and curated sample programs (Fibonacci, Mandelbrot mini).
2. Pure Vanilla JS/CSS3, zero external libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-tape-vm-debugger.js` verifying IR optimization parity vs unoptimized execution, unmatched-bracket error reporting, and cycle-limit infinite-loop protection.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Optimized IR execution matches unoptimized output 100% with fewer execution steps.
- [ ] Unbalanced brackets and infinite-loop step caps fail safely without freezing the UI.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-tape-vm-debugger.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Tools]: Client-Side IEEE-754 Float32/Float64 Bit-Layout & Rounding Error Explorer
body:
## Problem
Physics and shader developers frequently run into `0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3`, `NaN`, subnormals, and precision loss, yet ArcadeVerse has no interactive **IEEE-754** bit-level inspector.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/ieee754-bit-explorer.js` and `assets/css/ieee754-bit-explorer.css` (220+ LOC):
   - Use `DataView` (`Float32Array`/`Float64Array`/`BigUint64Array`) to decode and interactively toggle individual **Sign**, **Exponent**, and **Mantissa** bits in real time.
   - Display exact decimal value, hex representation, ULP (Unit in Last Place) spacing, and special-value presets (`-0`, `+Inf`, `NaN`, `Denormal Min`).
2. Pure Vanilla JS/CSS3, zero external libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-ieee754-bit-explorer.js` verifying exact Sign/Exponent/Mantissa bit extraction for `0.1`, `-0`, `Infinity`, `NaN`, and subnormal floats.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Clicking any of the 32 or 64 bits toggles the value and updates decimal/hex/ULP live.
- [ ] Correctly classifies Normal, Subnormal, Zero, Infinity, and NaN.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-ieee754-bit-explorer.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Tools]: Regex NFA/DFA Thompson Construction & State-Transition Graph Visualizer
body:
## Problem
ArcadeVerse has no **Thompson's Construction + Subset Construction** regular-expression engine visualizing how a regex compiles into an epsilon-NFA and minimized DFA.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. Create `assets/js/regex-nfa-dfa-lab.js` and `assets/css/regex-nfa-dfa-lab.css` (270+ LOC):
   - Implement regex parser (concatenation, alternation `|`, Kleene star `*`, plus `+`, optional `?`, grouping `()`), Thompson epsilon-NFA builder, and Subset Construction DFA converter.
   - Render interactive state-machine graph and step-by-step test-string matcher highlighting active states.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Canvas/CSS3, zero external libs, zero emojis. Do NOT edit `assets/js/games-registry.js`.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-regex-nfa-dfa-lab.js` verifying NFA and DFA acceptance parity against native `RegExp` on 20+ patterns.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Compiles valid regexes into both epsilon-NFA and deterministic DFA state graphs.
- [ ] NFA and DFA match results agree 100% across positive and negative test strings.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-regex-nfa-dfa-lab.js` passes cleanly under `node`.
